props.description: Settings for dependency signals to control how the health state of child entities influences the health state of the parent entity.
props.name: dependencies

props.description: Aggregation type for child dependencies.
props.name: aggregationType

props.description: Degraded threshold for aggregating the propagated health state of child dependencies. Can be either an absolute number that is greater than 0, or a percentage between 1-100%. The entity will be considered degraded when the number of not healthy child dependents (unhealthy, degraded, unknown) is equal to or above the threshold value. Must only be set when AggregationType is 'Thresholds'.
props.name: degradedThreshold

props.description: Unhealthy threshold for aggregating the propagated health state of child dependencies. Can be either an absolute number that is greater than 0, or a percentage between 1-100%. The entity will be considered unhealthy when the number of not healthy child dependents (unhealthy, degraded, unknown) is equal to or above the threshold value. Must only be set when AggregationType is 'Thresholds'.
props.name: unhealthyThreshold
